reply_text:
I answered Dana in a thread under her message in #north-team: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is IT ticket #4092. Ilse posted that number in #north-random on Oct 13 at 11:55, and Dana is a member of that channel. Ilse also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom, so I passed that on too.

I left out OPS-5546. That was Dana's private guess in her DM with me, and she asked me to keep it out of the channel.

The gbrain search failed with "requester_scope_required": the brain's access token isn't linked to a member, so it returned nothing. To fix it, someone needs to run `gbrain auth rescope` on the brain host. I found the answer by reading channels Dana is in instead.
